description: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of reasoning steps and the Pass@1 Rate for two models, GPT-4o and Claude-3.5-Sonnet. The x-axis represents the number of reasoning steps, with a linear scale, ranging from 5 to 40, and tick labels at 5, 10, 20, and 40. The y-axis represents the Pass@1 Rate in percentage, with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 100, and tick labels at intervals of 20. The GPT-4o line is depicted in dark blue with circle markers and a solid line style, starting at 6.5% at 5 reasoning steps and increasing to 83.9% at 40 reasoning steps, with notable increases to 32.3% at 10 steps and 77.4% at 20 steps. The Claude-3.5-Sonnet line is shown in light blue with cross markers and a solid line style, beginning at 19.4% at 5 reasoning steps and rising to 89.2% at 40 reasoning steps, with significant jumps to 38.7% at 10 steps and 87.1% at 20 steps.
